name: ajq
description: Route JSON and NDJSON semantic filtering and bounded classification tasks to ajq safely.

interface.longDescription:
Filter JSON and NDJSON records by meaning or classify text into a fixed set of labels with ajq. The skill helps you discover the installed CLI, validate queries with its deterministic mock backend, inspect the semantic plan, and run an explicitly selected model backend with a finite call cap.

Requires shell access and a separately installed ajq CLI. Real semantic judgments require a configured local or cloud backend; the plugin does not bundle a model. Ordinary jq operations stay deterministic. General-purpose semantic extraction and redaction are outside this skill's scope.

The plugin has no hosted service or usage telemetry. Input values can be sent to a cloud backend only when you select it, and successful semantic judgments are cached locally unless you disable the cache.
defaultPrompt: Use ajq to safely filter this JSON by meaning.
Classify these JSON lines with ajq and bounded labels.
Plan this ajq semantic query before running a model.
